description: This file contains shell script test cases for disabling HTTP in git operations, including setup of a test HTTP server, cloning repositories over HTTP/HTTPS, and testing protocol restrictions.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server used for the test scenarios.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates and commits an initial file in a repository for testing.

methods.name: git
methods.description: Executes git commands used in the test cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects a successful outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Grep output for specific patterns to verify test results.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
